request.summary: Usar OCR del pie impreso como fallback de identidad cuando no se pueda leer el QR de una página OMR.

objective: Implementar fallback acotado QR→OCR de pie para recuperar folio y página sin simular un QR firmado ni asignar páginas cuando la identidad resulte ambigua.
scope: Recortar la franja central inferior y reutilizar Tesseract.js existente en frontend
Parsear folio/página inequívocos, exigir confianza OCR de al menos 75/100 y reconciliar datos manuales
Cubrir abstención y prioridad QR con pruebas unitarias
Mantener la regresión OMR de marca X honesta respecto a la abstención por orientación no demostrada
constraints: No convertir texto OCR en payload QR ni alterar firmas
El backend sigue resolviendo el folio y página contra el examen y mapa existentes
Preservar cambios concurrentes ajenos del checkout

actions.summary: Agregada extracción conservadora del folio y página del pie; QR conserva prioridad y el fallback solicita revisión explícita en UI.

Pruebas cubren prioridad QR, fallback por error de identidad, conflicto manual, ausencia de texto y rechazo de página por defecto; prueba OMR conserva evidencia de X marcada, pero se abstiene sin orientación verificada.
Pruebas frontend focales 18/18, typecheck y ESLint focal aprobados; OMR X focal 1/1 aprobado con abstención esperada por fixture sin orientación verificable.

commands.name: omr_x_evidence_test
commands.command: npx vitest run tests/omr.test.ts -t "retiene evidencia de una X" --reporter=dot
commands.resultSummary: The X is retained as marked evidence and the answer remains ambiguous because this synthetic fixture does not establish page orientation; no production threshold was relaxed.

decisions: Attempt QR first. OCR only runs when the API fails identity/page resolution or succeeds without QR while folio/page input is incomplete.
Use Tesseract.js already declared in frontend; crop the centered lower 60% width strip, upscale 2x, require confidence >=75 and one unique folio/page pair.
Reject disagreement with any manually supplied identity and reject default-page success when QR is absent and the footer cannot be read.
Keep the X mark as a detected score while honoring the existing page-orientation abstention; the current fixture does not justify auto-selection.
assumptions: The printed footer format remains '<folio> · Pagina <n>' and the folio identifies an exam in the docente-scoped backend.
OCR confidence 75/100 is provisional and requires calibration against the real photo set.
risks: No real-photo OCR benchmark has been run; rotated pages, CamScanner degradation, and false matches to another valid folio remain unmeasured.
Tesseract language-data availability in offline desktop installs was not verified; OCR failure safely falls back to manual identity entry.
The X test is not evidence of automatic selection on a fully oriented page; it verifies marked evidence plus correct abstention under unknown orientation.
Full backend, coverage, release, physical-print, and photo-dataset suites were not run.
nextStep: Calibrate OCR footer recognition on QR-missed real captures and create a synthetic full-page case with verifiably detected orientation before expecting an X to become a selected answer.

pendingFields: Full-page oriented X fixture and OMR detector regression
